verdict.rationale: OCI's own docs describe its APIs as standard REST APIs over HTTPS. They also commit to 12 months' notice before breaking API changes, and back the API with official SDKs and a CLI, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically through a documented public API. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at common paths), independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven use, and detail on API reference and authentication flows in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure APIs are typical REST APIs that use HTTPS requests and responses.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure provides 12 months advance notice before the date of removing or changing an existing API of a Cloud Service that you have deployed which would require you to update the code.
Software Development Kits (SDKs) Build and deploy apps that integrate with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services.
